title: Point density contours
intent: Reveal the shape and overlap of Palmer Penguins bill measurements with a two-dimensional kernel density estimate.

ai.create: Create six filled density contours over Palmer Penguins bill measurements. Use each library's semantic density mark with an 18-pixel bandwidth and the supplied measurement scales.
ai.maintain: Preserve D3-native density thresholds, pixel bandwidth, scale domains, structured multipolygon output, and responsive final-screen estimation.
